race.comment: SETTLE PETAL (9) has found the line nicely in her last two and should also be hitting her straps now. Will drift back from the draw but the extra 200m suits and Crowther can have her humming late. Looks ready to break through now and is the best bet on the card. SECRET OWL (8) will find this a bit easier third-up and has improvement to come. Backs up quickly off nine days and is drawn cosy. Not underestimating. GINGERBREAD BOY (2) didn't fire fresh at Quorn when sent out equal fav but should sharpen up. Chance to steal a minor spot at a big quote. ANGRY BERDI (11) can improve sharply in her second look.
